shell: powershell
        run: |
          $url = "https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"
          $out = "winfsp.msi"
          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow

      - name: Create WinFsp MSI placeholder for resource glob
        shell: powershell
        run: New-Item -ItemType File -Force -Path "apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/winfsp-placeholder.msi"

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: windows-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: windows-cargo-

      - name: Cargo check with winfsp feature
        run: cargo check --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features winfsp

  cargo-check-macos:
    name: Cargo Check (macOS)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install FUSE-T
        run: |
          brew install --cask fuse-t
          sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig
          FUSE_T_PC="/Library/Application Support/fuse-t/pkgconfig/fuse-t.pc"
          if [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            FUSE_T_PC=$(find /Library /usr/local /opt/homebrew -name "fuse-t.pc" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
          fi
          if [ -z "$FUSE_T_PC" ] || [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            echo "::error::fuse-t.pc not found after FUSE-T installation"
            exit 1
          fi
          sudo cp "$FUSE_T_PC" /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc
          sudo sed -i '' 's/^Version:.*/Version: 2.9.9/' /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: macos-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: macos-cargo-

      - name: Cargo check with fuse feature
        working-directory: apps/desktop/src-tauri
        run: cargo check --no-default-features --features fuse
        env:
          PKG_CONFIG_PATH: /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig

  cargo-check-linux:
    name: Cargo Check (Linux)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install system dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
            libayatana-appindicator3-dev \
            librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            libxdo-dev \
            libfuse3-dev \
            pkg-config \
            build-essential

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: linux-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: linux-cargo-

      - name: Cargo check with fuse feature
        working-directory: apps/desktop/src-tauri
        run: cargo check --no-default-features --features fuse

  cargo-test-windows:
    name: Cargo Test (Windows)
    needs: [changes, cargo-check-windows]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      needs.cargo-check-windows.result == 'success'
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install WinFsp
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $url = "https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"
          $out = "winfsp.msi"
          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow

      - name: Create WinFsp MSI placeholder for resource glob
        shell: powershell
        run: New-Item -ItemType File -Force -Path "apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/winfsp-placeholder.msi"

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: windows-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: windows-cargo-

      - name: Run Rust tests
        run: cargo test --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features winfsp

  cargo-test-macos:
    name: Cargo Test (macOS)
    needs: [changes, cargo-check-macos]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      needs.cargo-check-macos.result == 'success'
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install FUSE-T
        run: |
          brew install --cask fuse-t
          sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig
          # fuser's build.rs looks for fuse.pc; FUSE-T ships fuse-t.pc
          # Copy instead of symlink to avoid dangling link if path varies
          FUSE_T_PC="/Library/Application Support/fuse-t/pkgconfig/fuse-t.pc"
          if [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            FUSE_T_PC=$(find /Library /usr/local /opt/homebrew -name "fuse-t.pc" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
          fi
          if [ -z "$FUSE_T_PC" ] || [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            echo "::error::fuse-t.pc not found after FUSE-T installation"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Found fuse-t.pc at: $FUSE_T_PC"
          sudo cp "$FUSE_T_PC" /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc
          # FUSE-T reports its product version (1.x) but implements the FUSE 2.9 API.
          # fuser's build.rs requires fuse >= 2.6.0, so fix the version to match.
          sudo sed -i '' 's/^Version:.*/Version: 2.9.9/' /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: macos-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: macos-cargo-

      - name: Run Rust tests
        run: cargo test --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features fuse
        env:
          PKG_CONFIG_PATH: /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig

  cargo-test-linux:
    name: Cargo Test + Coverage (Linux)
    needs: [changes, cargo-check-linux]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      needs.cargo-check-linux.result == 'success'
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install system dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
            libayatana-appindicator3-dev \
            librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            libxdo-dev \
            libfuse3-dev \
            pkg-config \
            build-essential

content.thinking:
Now I have a clear picture. Let me analyze the situation:

1. **cargo-check-windows** → **cargo-test-windows** (sequential, same runner type `windows-latest`)
2. **cargo-check-macos** → **cargo-test-macos** (sequential, same runner type `macos-latest`)
3. **cargo-check-linux** → **cargo-test-linux** (sequential, same runner type `ubuntu-22.04`)

Each pair uses the same cache key (e.g., `windows-cargo-${{ hashFiles('...Cargo.lock') }}`), which means they share the same `actions/cache@v4` entry. 

These are separate jobs on separate runner instances, so the check job writes to the cache and the test job reads from it, sharing compiled artifacts. The real question is whether `cargo check`'s output can be reused by `cargo test`. Since `cargo check` only produces metadata files without full codegen for the project's own crates, while `cargo test` needs complete compilation to generate test binaries, there's a mismatch in what each command produces.

However, `cargo check` does fully compile dependencies, so those cached artifacts are reusable by `cargo test`. With the same cache key across both jobs, the dependency artifacts from `cargo check` get restored and reused, but the project's own code still needs recompilation since `cargo check` didn't produce the full artifacts needed. So there's already some cache benefit, just not for the project code itself.

Now I'm realizing there's a limitation with how the cache action handles this... saves the cache on cache miss (or with `save-always`). If the cache key already exists from a previous run, neither job writes a new cache. The flow is:
1. Check job: restores cache (if exists) → runs check → saves cache (if it was a miss)
2. Test job: restores cache (same key) → runs test → saves cache (if miss)

But wait — both jobs run on DIFFERENT runner instances. The check job saves the cache after check, then the test job restores it. So the test job DOES get the check artifacts.

Actually, looking more carefully at `actions/cache@v4` behavior:
- Cache is saved on job success when there's a cache miss
- The test job runs AFTER the check job (via `needs`), so if the check job saves to cache, the test job should be able to restore it

But there's a catch: `actions/cache@v4` only saves when there was a cache miss on restore. If the cache key already existed (from a previous CI run), both jobs just restore the same old cache and neither saves an updated one.

On a first run or when Cargo.lock changes, the check job hits a cache miss, compiles everything, and saves it — then the test job restores those artifacts and only needs to compile test-specific stuff. On subsequent runs with the same Cargo.lock, both jobs hit cache and restore the old artifacts, so they run faster but don't get any new compiled artifacts. The current setup already shares artifacts between jobs, though there might be room for optimization.

The real challenge is that `cargo check` and `cargo test` use different compilation profiles — check only generates metadata for the local crate while test needs full codegen plus the test harness — so the check artifacts aren't directly reusable. What IS shared is the compiled dependencies in `target/debug/deps/` and the Cargo registry and git checkouts, which the cache already covers since both jobs use the same cache key. dependency metadata that helps cargo skip work. But the main cost—actually compiling the dependency code—isn't avoided since `cargo check` doesn't produce the full compiled output `cargo test` needs.

Good question. Let me look at the full picture of what's being cached and how the jobs relate.

**Current setup**: Each platform has `cargo-check-{os}` → `cargo-test-{os}` with the test job depending on check via `needs`. Both jobs use the same cache key:

```
{os}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
```

**What's already shared via cache**: The `actions/cache@v4` with matching keys means the test job restores whatever the check job (or a prior run) saved:
- `~/.cargo/registry` — crate source downloads
- `~/.cargo/git` — git dependency checkouts  
- `apps/desktop/src-tauri/target` — all compiled artifacts

**What `cargo check` produces that `cargo test` can reuse**:
- Fully compiled dependency crates (`.rlib` files) — `check` compiles all deps fully, it only skips codegen for your *own* crates
- Build script outputs (`target/debug/build/`)
- Dependency metadata

**What's NOT reusable**:
- Your project's own crates — `check` produces only `.rmeta` (metadata), but `test` needs full codegen + test harness binaries. This recompilation is unavoidable.

So the cache is already doing the heavy lifting. But the bigger optimization opportunity is: **the duplicate runner setup is the real waste**, not the compilation. Each test job repeats:
- Checkout
- Install system deps (WinFsp/FUSE-T/apt packages)
- Install Rust toolchain
- Cache restore

**The most impactful optimization would be merging each check+test pair into a single job** — run `cargo check` then `cargo test` sequentially in one job. You'd still get fast-fail (check fails → test doesn't run), but avoid all the duplicate setup overhead. On GitHub Actions, runner provisioning + setup easily adds 1-3 minutes per job.

The tradeoff is you lose the separate check/test status badges in the PR, but since test already gates on check succeeding, the signal is redundant. Would you want to explore that consolidation?

name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  changes:
    name: Detect Changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      src: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.src }}
      desktop: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.desktop }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            src:
              - 'apps/**'
              - 'packages/**'
              - 'tee-worker/**'
              - 'tests/**'
              - '.github/**'
              - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
              - 'pnpm-workspace.yaml'
              - 'tsconfig*.json'
              - 'biome.json'
            desktop:
              - 'apps/desktop/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/vendor/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/capabilities/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/build.rs'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/rust-toolchain.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/index.html'
              - 'apps/desktop/vite.config.*'
              - 'apps/desktop/tsconfig*'
              - 'packages/crypto/src/**'
              - 'packages/crypto/tsconfig*'
              - '.github/workflows/ci.yml'

  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run linter
        run: pnpm lint

  typecheck:
    name: Typecheck
    needs: [changes]
    if: |
      needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run type checker
        run: pnpm typecheck

  api-spec:
    name: Verify API Spec & Client
    needs: [changes]
    if: |
      needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: cipherbox_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
      ipfs:
        image: ipfs/kubo:v0.34.0
        ports:
          - 5001:5001
          - 8080:8080
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "ipfs id"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 10
          --health-start-period 30s
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Generate OpenAPI spec and API client
        run: pnpm api:generate
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080

      - name: Format generated files
        run: |
          pnpm eslint --fix apps/web/src/api/ || true
          pnpm prettier --write packages/api-client/openapi.json apps/web/src/api/

      - name: Verify no uncommitted changes to generated files
        run: |
          git diff --exit-code packages/api-client/openapi.json || (echo "OpenAPI spec is out of date. Run 'pnpm api:generate' and commit changes." && exit 1)
          git diff --exit-code apps/web/src/api/ || (echo "Generated API client is out of date. Run 'pnpm api:generate' and commit changes." && exit 1)

  migration-check:
    name: Migration Drift Check
    needs: [changes]
    if: |
      needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: cipherbox_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run existing migrations
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api migration:run
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

      - name: Check for entity/migration drift
        working-directory: apps/api
        run: |
          set +e
          OUTPUT="$(pnpm typeorm migration:generate src/migrations/DriftCheck -d src/data-source.ts 2>&1)"
          STATUS=$?
          set -e

          # Check if migration:generate failed before inspecting output files
          if [ "$STATUS" -ne 0 ]; then
            if echo "$OUTPUT" | grep -q "No changes in database schema were found"; then
              echo "No entity/migration drift detected."
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "::error::migration:generate failed unexpectedly."
            echo "$OUTPUT"
            exit 1
          fi

          if ls src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts 1>/dev/null 2>&1; then
            # Our hand-written migrations use explicit constraint/index names, but TypeORM
            # expects auto-generated hash-based names. Filter out cosmetic renames and only
            # fail on real structural drift (new/dropped tables, added/removed columns, type changes).
            if grep -qE 'CREATE TABLE|DROP TABLE|ADD COLUMN|DROP COLUMN|ALTER.*TYPE|RENAME COLUMN' src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts; then
              echo "::error::Entity/migration drift detected! Entities define schema changes not covered by migrations."
              echo ""
              echo "Generated migration contents:"
              cat src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts
              echo ""
              echo "Fix: Run 'pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api typeorm migration:generate src/migrations/<Name> -d src/data-source.ts' and commit the result."
              exit 1
            else
              echo "Only cosmetic constraint/index naming differences detected (not structural drift). OK."
            fi
          else
            echo "No entity/migration drift detected."
          fi
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

  test:
    name: Test
    needs: [changes, lint, typecheck]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: cipherbox_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
      ipfs:
        image: ipfs/kubo:v0.34.0
        ports:
          - 5001:5001
          - 8080:8080
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "ipfs id"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 10
          --health-start-period 30s
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run API tests with coverage
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api test:cov
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080

      - name: Run Crypto tests with coverage
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto test:coverage

      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: ./apps/api/coverage/lcov.info,./packages/crypto/coverage/lcov.info
          flags: api,crypto
          fail_ci_if_error: false

  build:
    name: Build
    needs: [changes, lint, typecheck, api-spec, test, migration-check]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build packages (excluding desktop)
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto --filter @cipherbox/api --filter @cipherbox/web build

  cargo-check-windows:
    name: Cargo Check (Windows)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install WinFsp
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $url = "https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"
          $out = "winfsp.msi"
          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow

      - name: Create WinFsp MSI placeholder for resource glob
        shell: powershell
        run: New-Item -ItemType File -Force -Path "apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/winfsp-placeholder.msi"

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: windows-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: windows-cargo-

      - name: Cargo check with winfsp feature
        run: cargo check --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features winfsp

  cargo-check-macos:
    name: Cargo Check (macOS)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install FUSE-T
        run: |
          brew install --cask fuse-t
          sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig
          FUSE_T_PC="/Library/Application Support/fuse-t/pkgconfig/fuse-t.pc"
          if [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            FUSE_T_PC=$(find /Library /usr/local /opt/homebrew -name "fuse-t.pc" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
          fi
          if [ -z "$FUSE_T_PC" ] || [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            echo "::error::fuse-t.pc not found after FUSE-T installation"
            exit 1
          fi
          sudo cp "$FUSE_T_PC" /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc
          sudo sed -i '' 's/^Version:.*/Version: 2.9.9/' /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: macos-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: macos-cargo-

      - name: Cargo check with fuse feature
        working-directory: apps/desktop/src-tauri
        run: cargo check --no-default-features --features fuse
        env:
          PKG_CONFIG_PATH: /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig

  cargo-check-linux:
    name: Cargo Check (Linux)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install system dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
            libayatana-appindicator3-dev \
            librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            libxdo-dev \
            libfuse3-dev \
            pkg-config \
            build-essential

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: linux-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: linux-cargo-

      - name: Cargo check with fuse feature
        working-directory: apps/desktop/src-tauri
        run: cargo check --no-default-features --features fuse

  cargo-test-windows:
    name: Cargo Test (Windows)
    needs: [changes, cargo-check-windows]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      needs.cargo-check-windows.result == 'success'
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install WinFsp
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $url = "https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"
          $out = "winfsp.msi"
          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow

      - name: Create WinFsp MSI placeholder for resource glob
        shell: powershell
        run: New-Item -ItemType File -Force -Path "apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/winfsp-placeholder.msi"

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: windows-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: windows-cargo-

      - name: Run Rust tests
        run: cargo test --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features winfsp

  cargo-test-macos:
    name: Cargo Test (macOS)
    needs: [changes, cargo-check-macos]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      needs.cargo-check-macos.result == 'success'
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install FUSE-T
        run: |
          brew install --cask fuse-t
          sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig
          # fuser's build.rs looks for fuse.pc; FUSE-T ships fuse-t.pc
          # Copy instead of symlink to avoid dangling link if path varies
          FUSE_T_PC="/Library/Application Support/fuse-t/pkgconfig/fuse-t.pc"
          if [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            FUSE_T_PC=$(find /Library /usr/local /opt/homebrew -name "fuse-t.pc" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
          fi
          if [ -z "$FUSE_T_PC" ] || [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            echo "::error::fuse-t.pc not found after FUSE-T installation"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Found fuse-t.pc at: $FUSE_T_PC"
          sudo cp "$FUSE_T_PC" /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc
          # FUSE-T reports its product version (1.x) but implements the FUSE 2.9 API.
          # fuser's build.rs requires fuse >= 2.6.0, so fix the version to match.
          sudo sed -i '' 's/^Version:.*/Version: 2.9.9/' /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: macos-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: macos-cargo-

      - name: Run Rust tests
        run: cargo test --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features fuse
        env:
          PKG_CONFIG_PATH: /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig

  cargo-test-linux:
    name: Cargo Test + Coverage (Linux)
    needs: [changes, cargo-check-linux]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      needs.cargo-check-linux.result == 'success'
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install system dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
            libayatana-appindicator3-dev \
            librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            libxdo-dev \
            libfuse3-dev \
            pkg-config \
            build-essential

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: linux-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: linux-cargo-

      - name: Install cargo-llvm-cov
        run: |
          rustup component add llvm-tools-preview
          cargo install cargo-llvm-cov --locked

      - name: Run Rust tests with coverage
        run: >-
          cargo llvm-cov
          --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml
          --no-default-features --features fuse
          --lcov --output-path desktop-lcov.info

      - name: Upload desktop coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: desktop-lcov.info
          flags: desktop
          fail_ci_if_error: false

1. **Windows**: merge `cargo-check-windows` + `cargo-test-windows` → `cargo-windows`

Each merged job runs `cargo check` first (fast-fail on type errors), then `cargo test`.

name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  changes:
    name: Detect Changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      src: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.src }}
      desktop: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.desktop }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            src:
              - 'apps/**'
              - 'packages/**'
              - 'tee-worker/**'
              - 'tests/**'
              - '.github/**'
              - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
              - 'pnpm-workspace.yaml'
              - 'tsconfig*.json'
              - 'biome.json'
            desktop:
              - 'apps/desktop/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/vendor/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/capabilities/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/build.rs'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/rust-toolchain.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/index.html'
              - 'apps/desktop/vite.config.*'
              - 'apps/desktop/tsconfig*'
              - 'packages/crypto/src/**'
              - 'packages/crypto/tsconfig*'
              - '.github/workflows/ci.yml'

  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run linter
        run: pnpm lint

  typecheck:
    name: Typecheck
    needs: [changes]
    if: |
      needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run type checker
        run: pnpm typecheck

  api-spec:
    name: Verify API Spec & Client
    needs: [changes]
    if: |
      needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: cipherbox_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
      ipfs:
        image: ipfs/kubo:v0.34.0
        ports:
          - 5001:5001
          - 8080:8080
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "ipfs id"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 10
          --health-start-period 30s
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Generate OpenAPI spec and API client
        run: pnpm api:generate
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080

      - name: Format generated files
        run: |
          pnpm eslint --fix apps/web/src/api/ || true
          pnpm prettier --write packages/api-client/openapi.json apps/web/src/api/

      - name: Verify no uncommitted changes to generated files
        run: |
          git diff --exit-code packages/api-client/openapi.json || (echo "OpenAPI spec is out of date. Run 'pnpm api:generate' and commit changes." && exit 1)
          git diff --exit-code apps/web/src/api/ || (echo "Generated API client is out of date. Run 'pnpm api:generate' and commit changes." && exit 1)

  migration-check:
    name: Migration Drift Check
    needs: [changes]
    if: |
      needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'

          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

      - name: Check for entity/migration drift
        working-directory: apps/api
        run: |
          set +e
          OUTPUT="$(pnpm typeorm migration:generate src/migrations/DriftCheck -d src/data-source.ts 2>&1)"
          STATUS=$?
          set -e

          # Check if migration:generate failed before inspecting output files
          if [ "$STATUS" -ne 0 ]; then
            if echo "$OUTPUT" | grep -q "No changes in database schema were found"; then
              echo "No entity/migration drift detected."
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "::error::migration:generate failed unexpectedly."
            echo "$OUTPUT"
            exit 1
          fi

            # expects auto-generated hash-based names. Filter out cosmetic renames and only
            # fail on real structural drift (new/dropped tables, added/removed columns, type changes).
            if grep -qE 'CREATE TABLE|DROP TABLE|ADD COLUMN|DROP COLUMN|ALTER.*TYPE|RENAME COLUMN' src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts; then
              echo "::error::Entity/migration drift detected! Entities define schema changes not covered by migrations."
              echo ""
              echo "Generated migration contents:"
              cat src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts
              echo ""
              echo "Fix: Run 'pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api typeorm migration:generate src/migrations/<Name> -d src/data-source.ts' and commit the result."
              exit 1
            else
              echo "Only cosmetic constraint/index naming differences detected (not structural drift). OK."
            fi
          else
            echo "No entity/migration drift detected."
          fi

          DB_PORT: 5432

          DB_PASSWORD: postgres

          flags: api,crypto
          fail_ci_if_error: false

  build:
    name: Build
    needs: [changes, lint, typecheck, api-spec, test, migration-check]

        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4

          key: macos-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: macos-cargo-

      - name: Run Rust tests
        run: cargo test --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features fuse
        env:
          PKG_CONFIG_PATH: /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig

  cargo-test-linux:
    name: Cargo Test + Coverage (Linux)
    needs: [changes, cargo-check-linux]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      needs.cargo-check-linux.result == 'success'
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install system dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
            libayatana-appindicator3-dev \
            librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            libxdo-dev \
            libfuse3-dev \
            pkg-config \
            build-essential

      - name: Install Rust toolchain

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:

            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: linux-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: linux-cargo-

      - name: Install cargo-llvm-cov
        run: |
          rustup component add llvm-tools-preview
          cargo install cargo-llvm-cov --locked

      - name: Run Rust tests with coverage
        run: >-
          cargo llvm-cov
          --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml
          --no-default-features --features fuse
          --lcov --output-path desktop-lcov.info

      - name: Upload desktop coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: desktop-lcov.info
          flags: desktop
          fail_ci_if_error: false

name: Release Gate

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  detect-changes:
    name: Detect Changes Since Last Release
    if: startsWith(github.head_ref, 'release-please--')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      desktop: ${{ steps.check.outputs.desktop }}
      prev_tag: ${{ steps.check.outputs.prev_tag }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Check for desktop-related changes since last release
        id: check
        run: |
          # Find the latest non-staging release tag
          PREV_TAG=$(git tag --list 'v*' --sort=-v:refname \
            | grep -v 'staging' \
            | head -1)

          if [ -z "$PREV_TAG" ]; then
            echo "No previous release tag found — assuming desktop changed"
            echo "desktop=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "prev_tag=" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            exit 0
          fi

          echo "Previous release tag: ${PREV_TAG}"
          echo "prev_tag=${PREV_TAG}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Diffing ${PREV_TAG}..HEAD"

          # Desktop-related path patterns (mirrored from e2e-desktop.yml)
          DESKTOP_PATTERNS=(
            'apps/desktop/src/'
            'apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/'
            'apps/desktop/src-tauri/vendor/'
            'apps/desktop/src-tauri/capabilities/'
            'apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/'
            'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml'
            'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock'
            'apps/desktop/src-tauri/build.rs'
            'apps/desktop/src-tauri/rust-toolchain.toml'
            'apps/desktop/index.html'
            'apps/desktop/vite.config.'
            'apps/desktop/tsconfig'
            'packages/crypto/src/'
            'packages/crypto/tsconfig'
            '.github/workflows/e2e-desktop.yml'
          )

          CHANGED_FILES=$(git diff --name-only "${PREV_TAG}..HEAD")
          DESKTOP_CHANGED=false

          for pattern in "${DESKTOP_PATTERNS[@]}"; do
            if echo "$CHANGED_FILES" | grep -Fq "$pattern"; then
              echo "Desktop change detected matching pattern: ${pattern}"
              DESKTOP_CHANGED=true
              break
            fi
          done

          echo "desktop=${DESKTOP_CHANGED}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Desktop changes detected: ${DESKTOP_CHANGED}"

  verify-e2e:
    name: Verify E2E Passed
    needs: detect-changes
    if: startsWith(github.head_ref, 'release-please--')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 40
    steps:
      - name: Wait for Web E2E and verify it passed
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          # Get the latest commit on main (the base the release PR targets)
          MAIN_SHA=$(gh api repos/${{ github.repository }}/git/ref/heads/main --jq '.object.sha')
          echo "Latest main commit: ${MAIN_SHA}"

          # Poll for the Web E2E run to complete (it triggers on the same push)
          MAX_ATTEMPTS=30
          POLL_INTERVAL=30
          echo "Waiting for Web E2E run to complete (polling every ${POLL_INTERVAL}s, max ${MAX_ATTEMPTS} attempts)..."

          for attempt in $(seq 1 $MAX_ATTEMPTS); do
            E2E_CONCLUSION=$(gh run list --repo ${{ github.repository }} \
              --workflow=e2e.yml --branch=main --limit=10 \
              --json headSha,conclusion,status \
              --jq "[.[] | select(.headSha == \"${MAIN_SHA}\")][0].conclusion // empty")

            if [ -n "$E2E_CONCLUSION" ]; then
              echo "Web E2E completed with conclusion: ${E2E_CONCLUSION}"
              break
            fi

            if [ "$attempt" -eq "$MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; then
              echo "::error::Web E2E run did not complete within $(( MAX_ATTEMPTS * POLL_INTERVAL / 60 )) minutes for main (${MAIN_SHA})."
              exit 1
            fi

            echo "Attempt ${attempt}/${MAX_ATTEMPTS}: E2E still running, waiting ${POLL_INTERVAL}s..."
            sleep $POLL_INTERVAL
          done

          if [ "$E2E_CONCLUSION" != "success" ]; then
            echo "::error::E2E Tests did not pass on main (conclusion: ${E2E_CONCLUSION})"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Web E2E: passed"

      - name: Verify Desktop E2E (if desktop changed)
        if: needs.detect-changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          PREV_TAG: ${{ needs.detect-changes.outputs.prev_tag }}
        run: |
          MAIN_SHA=$(gh api repos/${{ github.repository }}/git/ref/heads/main --jq '.object.sha')
          echo "Desktop changes detected since ${PREV_TAG} — verifying Desktop E2E"

          # First check if there's a desktop E2E run for HEAD (may still be running)
          HEAD_STATUS=$(gh run list --repo ${{ github.repository }} \
            --workflow=e2e-desktop.yml --branch=main --limit=5 \
            --json headSha,conclusion,status \
            --jq "[.[] | select(.headSha == \"${MAIN_SHA}\")][0].status // empty")

          if [ -n "$HEAD_STATUS" ]; then
            echo "Desktop E2E run exists for HEAD — polling until complete..."
            MAX_ATTEMPTS=40
            POLL_INTERVAL=30

            for attempt in $(seq 1 $MAX_ATTEMPTS); do
              CONCLUSION=$(gh run list --repo ${{ github.repository }} \
                --workflow=e2e-desktop.yml --branch=main --limit=5 \
                --json headSha,conclusion,status \
                --jq "[.[] | select(.headSha == \"${MAIN_SHA}\")][0].conclusion // empty")

              if [ -n "$CONCLUSION" ]; then
                if [ "$CONCLUSION" != "success" ]; then
                  echo "::error::Desktop E2E Tests did not pass on main (conclusion: ${CONCLUSION})"
                  exit 1
                fi
                echo "Desktop E2E: passed (at HEAD)"
                exit 0
              fi

              if [ "$attempt" -eq "$MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; then
                echo "::error::Desktop E2E run did not complete within $(( MAX_ATTEMPTS * POLL_INTERVAL / 60 )) minutes."
                exit 1
              fi

              echo "Attempt ${attempt}/${MAX_ATTEMPTS}: Desktop E2E still running, waiting ${POLL_INTERVAL}s..."
              sleep $POLL_INTERVAL
            done
          fi

          # No desktop E2E run for HEAD — find the most recent run in the
          # release range and verify it succeeded (covers desktop state at HEAD)
          echo "No Desktop E2E run for HEAD — checking for recent run since ${PREV_TAG}..."

          # Get commit SHAs in the release range
          RANGE_COMMITS=$(gh api "repos/${{ github.repository }}/compare/${PREV_TAG}...${MAIN_SHA}" \
            --jq '[.commits[].sha] | join("\n")' 2>/dev/null || echo "")

          if [ -z "$RANGE_COMMITS" ]; then
            echo "::error::Could not determine commits in range ${PREV_TAG}..${MAIN_SHA}"
            exit 1
          fi

          # Get recent desktop E2E runs (newest first) and find the most recent
          # one whose commit is within the release range
          RUNS=$(gh run list --repo ${{ github.repository }} \
            --workflow=e2e-desktop.yml --branch=main --limit=20 \
            --json headSha,conclusion \
            --jq '.[] | "\(.headSha) \(.conclusion)"')

          LATEST_IN_RANGE_SHA=""
          LATEST_IN_RANGE_CONCLUSION=""

          while IFS=" " read -r sha conclusion; do
            if [ -z "$sha" ]; then
              continue
            fi
            if echo "$RANGE_COMMITS" | grep -Fq "$sha"; then
              LATEST_IN_RANGE_SHA="$sha"
              LATEST_IN_RANGE_CONCLUSION="$conclusion"
              break
            fi
          done <<EOF
          $RUNS
          EOF

          if [ -z "$LATEST_IN_RANGE_SHA" ]; then
            echo "::error::No Desktop E2E run found for any commit in ${PREV_TAG}..HEAD. Desktop code changed but was never verified."
            exit 1
          fi

          if [ "$LATEST_IN_RANGE_CONCLUSION" != "success" ]; then
            echo "::error::Most recent Desktop E2E run in range (at ${LATEST_IN_RANGE_SHA}) did not succeed (conclusion: ${LATEST_IN_RANGE_CONCLUSION})."
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "Desktop E2E: passed (most recent in-range run at ${LATEST_IN_RANGE_SHA} succeeded)"

      - name: Skip Desktop E2E (no desktop changes)
        if: needs.detect-changes.outputs.desktop != 'true'
        run: echo "No desktop-related changes since last release — skipping Desktop E2E gate"

      - name: Summary
        run: echo "All E2E gates passed — release is safe to merge."

cargo-windows:
    name: Cargo Check & Test (Windows)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install WinFsp
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $url = "https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"
          $out = "winfsp.msi"
          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow

      - name: Create WinFsp MSI placeholder for resource glob
        shell: powershell
        run: New-Item -ItemType File -Force -Path "apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/winfsp-placeholder.msi"

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: windows-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: windows-cargo-

      - name: Cargo check
        run: cargo check --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features winfsp

      - name: Cargo test
        run: cargo test --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features winfsp

  cargo-macos:
    name: Cargo Check & Test (macOS)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install FUSE-T
        run: |
          brew install --cask fuse-t
          sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig
          FUSE_T_PC="/Library/Application Support/fuse-t/pkgconfig/fuse-t.pc"
          if [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            FUSE_T_PC=$(find /Library /usr/local /opt/homebrew -name "fuse-t.pc" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
          fi
          if [ -z "$FUSE_T_PC" ] || [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            echo "::error::fuse-t.pc not found after FUSE-T installation"
            exit 1
          fi
          sudo cp "$FUSE_T_PC" /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc
          sudo sed -i '' 's/^Version:.*/Version: 2.9.9/' /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: macos-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: macos-cargo-

      - name: Cargo check
        working-directory: apps/desktop/src-tauri
        run: cargo check --no-default-features --features fuse
        env:
          PKG_CONFIG_PATH: /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig

      - name: Cargo test
        run: cargo test --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features fuse
        env:
          PKG_CONFIG_PATH: /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig

  cargo-linux:
    name: Cargo Check, Test & Coverage (Linux)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install system dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
            libayatana-appindicator3-dev \
            librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            libxdo-dev \
            libfuse3-dev \
            pkg-config \
            build-essential

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: linux-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: linux-cargo-

      - name: Cargo check
        working-directory: apps/desktop/src-tauri
        run: cargo check --no-default-features --features fuse

      - name: Install cargo-llvm-cov
        run: |
          rustup component add llvm-tools-preview
          cargo install cargo-llvm-cov --locked

      - name: Cargo test with coverage
        run: >-
          cargo llvm-cov
          --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml
          --no-default-features --features fuse
          --lcov --output-path desktop-lcov.info

      - name: Upload desktop coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: desktop-lcov.info
          flags: desktop
          fail_ci_if_error: false

ci: consolidate cargo check+test into single jobs per platform

unified cargo-{os} jobs that run check then test sequentially. This

installation, and cache restore across 3 platforms — saving several
minutes of CI wall time per run.

**Before:** 6 jobs (3 check + 3 test), each provisioning its own runner, installing deps, and restoring cache separately.

Done. Updated the required status checks on `main`:

**Removed (6):**
- `Cargo Check (Windows)`, `Cargo Check (macOS)`, `Cargo Check (Linux)`
- `Cargo Test (Windows)`, `Cargo Test (macOS)`, `Cargo Test + Coverage (Linux)`

**Added (3):**
- `Cargo Check & Test (Windows)`
- `Cargo Check & Test (macOS)`
- `Cargo Check, Test & Coverage (Linux)`

The PR should no longer be blocked by the old check names.

# Resolve PR Review Comments

Resolve all open review comments on the current PR from any automated reviewer (CodeRabbit, GitHub Copilot, etc.) or human reviewers.

## Workflow

### 1. Identify the PR

```bash
PR_NUMBER=$(gh pr view --json number --jq '.number')
```

If no PR exists for the current branch, stop and inform the user.

### 2. Fetch all unresolved review threads

Use the GraphQL `reviewThreads` query to get threads with `isResolved` status:

```bash
REPO_OWNER=$(gh repo view --json owner --jq '.owner.login')
REPO_NAME=$(gh repo view --json name --jq '.name')

gh api graphql -f query="
{
  repository(owner: \"$REPO_OWNER\", name: \"$REPO_NAME\") {
    pullRequest(number: $PR_NUMBER) {
      reviewThreads(first: 100) {
        nodes {
          id
          isResolved
          comments(first: 10) {
            nodes {
              id
              author { login }
              body
              path
              line
              createdAt
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}"
```

Filter to only unresolved threads. If none, report "No unresolved review threads" and stop.

### 3. Triage each comment

For each unresolved thread, read the comment and the referenced code. Categorize as:

- **Valid fix needed** — the comment identifies a real bug, security issue, or meaningful improvement
- **Already addressed** — the issue was fixed in a later commit on this branch
- **Not applicable** — the suggestion doesn't apply (explain why)

### 4. Implement fixes

For all "valid fix needed" comments:

1. Read the referenced file and understand the context
2. Implement the fix
3. Track which thread the fix addresses

Do NOT:

- Make unrelated changes or refactors
- Add features beyond what the comment requests
- Increase timeouts or add retries as a first approach — fix root causes

### 5. Run tests locally

After ALL fixes are implemented:

```bash
# Type check
pnpm typecheck

# Run relevant unit tests
pnpm test

# If E2E-relevant changes were made, run E2E tests too
cd tests/e2e && pnpm exec playwright test
```

Do NOT proceed to commit until tests pass. If tests fail, fix the failures first.

### 6. Commit and push

```bash
git add <specific-files>
git commit -m "fix: address PR review comments"
git push
```

### 7. Reply to and resolve each thread

For each thread, reply explaining what was done, then resolve:

- **Fixed comments**: Reply with what was changed and where, then resolve
- **Already addressed**: Reply explaining which commit addressed it, then resolve
- **Not applicable**: Reply with clear reasoning for not making changes, then resolve

Reply via REST (use `--field` not `-f` for `in_reply_to` — must be integer):

```bash
gh api repos/$REPO_OWNER/$REPO_NAME/pulls/$PR_NUMBER/comments \
  --field in_reply_to=COMMENT_ID \
  --raw-field body='...'
```

Resolve via GraphQL (can batch multiple):

```bash
gh api graphql -f query='
mutation {
  resolveReviewThread(input: {threadId: "THREAD_ID"}) {
    thread { isResolved }
  }
}'
```

### 8. Report summary

Print a summary table:

- Thread count resolved
- Fixes made (with file:line references)
- Comments marked as already addressed or not applicable

- name: Verify Desktop E2E (if desktop changed)
        if: needs.detect-changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          PREV_TAG: ${{ needs.detect-changes.outputs.prev_tag }}
        run: |
          MAIN_SHA=$(gh api repos/${{ github.repository }}/git/ref/heads/main --jq '.object.sha')
          echo "Desktop changes detected since ${PREV_TAG} — verifying Desktop E2E"

          # First check if there's a desktop E2E run for HEAD (may still be running)
          HEAD_STATUS=$(gh run list --repo ${{ github.repository }} \
            --workflow=e2e-desktop.yml --branch=main --limit=5 \
            --json headSha,conclusion,status \
            --jq "[.[] | select(.headSha == \"${MAIN_SHA}\")][0].status // empty")

          if [ -n "$HEAD_STATUS" ]; then
            echo "Desktop E2E run exists for HEAD — polling until complete..."
            MAX_ATTEMPTS=40
            POLL_INTERVAL=30

            for attempt in $(seq 1 $MAX_ATTEMPTS); do
              CONCLUSION=$(gh run list --repo ${{ github.repository }} \
                --workflow=e2e-desktop.yml --branch=main --limit=5 \
                --json headSha,conclusion,status \
                --jq "[.[] | select(.headSha == \"${MAIN_SHA}\")][0].conclusion // empty")

              if [ -n "$CONCLUSION" ]; then
                if [ "$CONCLUSION" != "success" ]; then
                  echo "::error::Desktop E2E Tests did not pass on main (conclusion: ${CONCLUSION})"
                  exit 1
                fi
                echo "Desktop E2E: passed (at HEAD)"
                exit 0
              fi

              if [ "$attempt" -eq "$MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; then
                echo "::error::Desktop E2E run did not complete within $(( MAX_ATTEMPTS * POLL_INTERVAL / 60 )) minutes."
                exit 1
              fi

              echo "Attempt ${attempt}/${MAX_ATTEMPTS}: Desktop E2E still running, waiting ${POLL_INTERVAL}s..."
              sleep $POLL_INTERVAL
            done
          fi

          # No desktop E2E run for HEAD — find the most recent run in the
          # release range and verify it succeeded (covers desktop state at HEAD)
          echo "No Desktop E2E run for HEAD — checking for recent run since ${PREV_TAG}..."

          # Get commit SHAs in the release range
          RANGE_COMMITS=$(gh api "repos/${{ github.repository }}/compare/${PREV_TAG}...${MAIN_SHA}" \
            --jq '[.commits[].sha] | join("\n")' 2>/dev/null || echo "")

          if [ -z "$RANGE_COMMITS" ]; then
            echo "::error::Could not determine commits in range ${PREV_TAG}..${MAIN_SHA}"
            exit 1
          fi

          # Get recent desktop E2E runs (newest first) and find the most recent
          # one whose commit is within the release range
          RUNS=$(gh run list --repo ${{ github.repository }} \
            --workflow=e2e-desktop.yml --branch=main --limit=20 \
            --json headSha,conclusion \
            --jq '.[] | "\(.headSha) \(.conclusion)"')

          LATEST_IN_RANGE_SHA=""
          LATEST_IN_RANGE_CONCLUSION=""

          while IFS=" " read -r sha conclusion; do
            if [ -z "$sha" ]; then
              continue
            fi
            if echo "$RANGE_COMMITS" | grep -Fq "$sha"; then
              LATEST_IN_RANGE_SHA="$sha"
              LATEST_IN_RANGE_CONCLUSION="$conclusion"
              break
            fi
          done <<EOF
          $RUNS
          EOF

          if [ -z "$LATEST_IN_RANGE_SHA" ]; then
            echo "::error::No Desktop E2E run found for any commit in ${PREV_TAG}..HEAD. Desktop code changed but was never verified."
            exit 1
          fi

          if [ "$LATEST_IN_RANGE_CONCLUSION" != "success" ]; then
            echo "::error::Most recent Desktop E2E run in range (at ${LATEST_IN_RANGE_SHA}) did not succeed (conclusion: ${LATEST_IN_RANGE_CONCLUSION})."
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "Desktop E2E: passed (most recent in-range run at ${LATEST_IN_RANGE_SHA} succeeded)"

      - name: Skip Desktop E2E (no desktop changes)
        if: needs.detect-changes.outputs.desktop != 'true'
        run: echo "No desktop-related changes since last release — skipping Desktop E2E gate"

      - name: Summary
        run: echo "All E2E gates passed — release is safe to merge."

name: Release Gate

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  detect-changes:
    name: Detect Changes Since Last Release
    if: startsWith(github.head_ref, 'release-please--')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      desktop: ${{ steps.check.outputs.desktop }}
      prev_tag: ${{ steps.check.outputs.prev_tag }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Check for desktop-related changes since last release
        id: check
        run: |
          # Find the latest non-staging release tag
          PREV_TAG=$(git tag --list 'v*' --sort=-v:refname \
            | grep -v 'staging' \
            | head -1)

          if [ -z "$PREV_TAG" ]; then
            echo "No previous release tag found — assuming desktop changed"
            echo "desktop=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "prev_tag=" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            exit 0
          fi

          echo "Previous release tag: ${PREV_TAG}"
          echo "prev_tag=${PREV_TAG}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Diffing ${PREV_TAG}..HEAD"

          # Desktop-related path patterns (mirrored from e2e-desktop.yml)
          DESKTOP_PATTERNS=(
            'apps/desktop/src/'
            'apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/'
            'apps/desktop/src-tauri/vendor/'
            'apps/desktop/src-tauri/capabilities/'
            'apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/'
            'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml'
            'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock'
            'apps/desktop/src-tauri/build.rs'
            'apps/desktop/src-tauri/rust-toolchain.toml'
            'apps/desktop/index.html'
            'apps/desktop/vite.config.'
            'apps/desktop/tsconfig'
            'packages/crypto/src/'
            'packages/crypto/tsconfig'
            '.github/workflows/e2e-desktop.yml'
          )

          CHANGED_FILES=$(git diff --name-only "${PREV_TAG}..HEAD")
          DESKTOP_CHANGED=false

          for pattern in "${DESKTOP_PATTERNS[@]}"; do
            if echo "$CHANGED_FILES" | grep -Fq "$pattern"; then
              echo "Desktop change detected matching pattern: ${pattern}"
              DESKTOP_CHANGED=true
              break
            fi
          done

          echo "desktop=${DESKTOP_CHANGED}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Desktop changes detected: ${DESKTOP_CHANGED}"

  verify-e2e:
    name: Verify E2E Passed
    needs: detect-changes
    if: startsWith(github.head_ref, 'release-please--')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 40
    steps:
      - name: Wait for Web E2E and verify it passed
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          # Get the latest commit on main (the base the release PR targets)
          MAIN_SHA=$(gh api repos/${{ github.repository }}/git/ref/heads/main --jq '.object.sha')
          echo "Latest main commit: ${MAIN_SHA}"

          # Poll for the Web E2E run to complete (it triggers on the same push)
          MAX_ATTEMPTS=30
          POLL_INTERVAL=30
          echo "Waiting for Web E2E run to complete (polling every ${POLL_INTERVAL}s, max ${MAX_ATTEMPTS} attempts)..."

          for attempt in $(seq 1 $MAX_ATTEMPTS); do
            E2E_CONCLUSION=$(gh run list --repo ${{ github.repository }} \
              --workflow=e2e.yml --branch=main --limit=10 \
              --json headSha,conclusion,status \
              --jq "[.[] | select(.headSha == \"${MAIN_SHA}\")][0].conclusion // empty")

            if [ -n "$E2E_CONCLUSION" ]; then
              echo "Web E2E completed with conclusion: ${E2E_CONCLUSION}"
              break
            fi

            if [ "$attempt" -eq "$MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; then
              echo "::error::Web E2E run did not complete within $(( MAX_ATTEMPTS * POLL_INTERVAL / 60 )) minutes for main (${MAIN_SHA})."
              exit 1
            fi

            echo "Attempt ${attempt}/${MAX_ATTEMPTS}: E2E still running, waiting ${POLL_INTERVAL}s..."
            sleep $POLL_INTERVAL
          done

          if [ "$E2E_CONCLUSION" != "success" ]; then
            echo "::error::E2E Tests did not pass on main (conclusion: ${E2E_CONCLUSION})"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Web E2E: passed"

      - name: Verify Desktop E2E (if desktop changed)
        if: needs.detect-changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          PREV_TAG: ${{ needs.detect-changes.outputs.prev_tag }}
        run: |
          MAIN_SHA=$(gh api repos/${{ github.repository }}/git/ref/heads/main --jq '.object.sha')
          echo "Desktop changes detected since ${PREV_TAG} — verifying Desktop E2E"

          # First check if there's a desktop E2E run for HEAD (may still be running)
          HEAD_STATUS=$(gh run list --repo ${{ github.repository }} \
            --workflow=e2e-desktop.yml --branch=main --limit=5 \
            --json headSha,conclusion,status \
            --jq "[.[] | select(.headSha == \"${MAIN_SHA}\")][0].status // empty")

          if [ -n "$HEAD_STATUS" ]; then
            echo "Desktop E2E run exists for HEAD — polling until complete..."
            MAX_ATTEMPTS=40
            POLL_INTERVAL=30

            for attempt in $(seq 1 $MAX_ATTEMPTS); do
              CONCLUSION=$(gh run list --repo ${{ github.repository }} \
                --workflow=e2e-desktop.yml --branch=main --limit=5 \
                --json headSha,conclusion,status \
                --jq "[.[] | select(.headSha == \"${MAIN_SHA}\")][0].conclusion // empty")

              if [ -n "$CONCLUSION" ]; then
                if [ "$CONCLUSION" != "success" ]; then
                  echo "::error::Desktop E2E Tests did not pass on main (conclusion: ${CONCLUSION})"
                  exit 1
                fi
                echo "Desktop E2E: passed (at HEAD)"
                exit 0
              fi

              if [ "$attempt" -eq "$MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; then
                echo "::error::Desktop E2E run did not complete within $(( MAX_ATTEMPTS * POLL_INTERVAL / 60 )) minutes."
                exit 1
              fi

              echo "Attempt ${attempt}/${MAX_ATTEMPTS}: Desktop E2E still running, waiting ${POLL_INTERVAL}s..."
              sleep $POLL_INTERVAL
            done
          fi

          # No desktop E2E run for HEAD — find the most recent run in the
          # release range and verify it succeeded (covers desktop state at HEAD)
          echo "No Desktop E2E run for HEAD — checking for recent run since ${PREV_TAG}..."

          # Get commit SHAs in the release range
          RANGE_COMMITS=$(gh api "repos/${{ github.repository }}/compare/${PREV_TAG}...${MAIN_SHA}" \
            --jq '[.commits[].sha] | join("\n")' 2>/dev/null || echo "")

          if [ -z "$RANGE_COMMITS" ]; then
            echo "::error::Could not determine commits in range ${PREV_TAG}..${MAIN_SHA}"
            exit 1
          fi

          # Get recent desktop E2E runs (newest first) and find the most recent
          # one whose commit is within the release range
          RUNS=$(gh run list --repo ${{ github.repository }} \

            --json headSha,conclusion \

# Resolve PR Review Comments

Resolve all open review comments on the current PR from any automated reviewer (CodeRabbit, GitHub Copilot, etc.) or human reviewers.

## Workflow

### 1. Identify the PR

```bash
PR_NUMBER=$(gh pr view --json number --jq '.number')
```

If no PR exists for the current branch, stop and inform the user.

### 2. Fetch all unresolved review threads

Use the GraphQL `reviewThreads` query to get threads with `isResolved` status:

```bash
REPO_OWNER=$(gh repo view --json owner --jq '.owner.login')
REPO_NAME=$(gh repo view --json name --jq '.name')

gh api graphql -f query="
{
  repository(owner: \"$REPO_OWNER\", name: \"$REPO_NAME\") {
    pullRequest(number: $PR_NUMBER) {
      reviewThreads(first: 100) {
        nodes {
          id
          isResolved
          comments(first: 10) {
            nodes {
              id
              author { login }
              body
              path
              line
              createdAt
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}"
```

Filter to only unresolved threads. If none, report "No unresolved review threads" and stop.

### 3. Triage each comment

For each unresolved thread, read the comment and the referenced code. Categorize as:

- **Valid fix needed** — the comment identifies a real bug, security issue, or meaningful improvement
- **Already addressed** — the issue was fixed in a later commit on this branch
- **Not applicable** — the suggestion doesn't apply (explain why)

### 4. Implement fixes

For all "valid fix needed" comments:

1. Read the referenced file and understand the context
2. Implement the fix
3. Track which thread the fix addresses

Do NOT:

- Make unrelated changes or refactors
- Add features beyond what the comment requests
- Increase timeouts or add retries as a first approach — fix root causes

### 5. Run tests locally

After ALL fixes are implemented:

```bash
# Type check
pnpm typecheck

# Run relevant unit tests
pnpm test

# If E2E-relevant changes were made, run E2E tests too
cd tests/e2e && pnpm exec playwright test
```

Do NOT proceed to commit until tests pass. If tests fail, fix the failures first.

### 6. Commit and push

```bash
git add <specific-files>
git commit -m "fix: address PR review comments"
git push
```

### 7. Reply to and resolve each thread

For each thread, reply explaining what was done, then resolve:

- **Fixed comments**: Reply with what was changed and where, then resolve
- **Already addressed**: Reply explaining which commit addressed it, then resolve
- **Not applicable**: Reply with clear reasoning for not making changes, then resolve

```bash

  --raw-field body='...'
```

Resolve via GraphQL (can batch multiple):

```bash
gh api graphql -f query='
mutation {
  resolveReviewThread(input: {threadId: "THREAD_ID"}) {
    thread { isResolved }
  }
}'
```

### 8. Report summary

Print a summary table:

- Thread count resolved
- Fixes made (with file:line references)
- Comments marked as already addressed or not applicable

name: Release Gate

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  detect-changes:
    name: Detect Changes Since Last Release
    if: startsWith(github.head_ref, 'release-please--')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      desktop: ${{ steps.check.outputs.desktop }}
      prev_tag: ${{ steps.check.outputs.prev_tag }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Check for desktop-related changes since last release
        id: check
        run: |
          # Find the latest non-staging release tag
          PREV_TAG=$(git tag --list 'v*' --sort=-v:refname \
            | grep -v 'staging' \
            | head -1)

          if [ -z "$PREV_TAG" ]; then
            echo "No previous release tag found — assuming desktop changed"
            echo "desktop=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "prev_tag=" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            exit 0
          fi

          echo "Previous release tag: ${PREV_TAG}"
          echo "prev_tag=${PREV_TAG}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Diffing ${PREV_TAG}..HEAD"

          # Desktop-related path patterns (mirrored from e2e-desktop.yml)
          DESKTOP_PATTERNS=(
            'apps/desktop/src/'
            'apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/'
            'apps/desktop/src-tauri/vendor/'
            'apps/desktop/src-tauri/capabilities/'
            'apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/'
            'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml'
            'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock'
            'apps/desktop/src-tauri/build.rs'
            'apps/desktop/src-tauri/rust-toolchain.toml'
            'apps/desktop/index.html'
            'apps/desktop/vite.config.'
            'apps/desktop/tsconfig'
            'packages/crypto/src/'
            'packages/crypto/tsconfig'
            '.github/workflows/e2e-desktop.yml'
          )

          CHANGED_FILES=$(git diff --name-only "${PREV_TAG}..HEAD")
          DESKTOP_CHANGED=false

          for pattern in "${DESKTOP_PATTERNS[@]}"; do
            if echo "$CHANGED_FILES" | grep -Fq "$pattern"; then
              echo "Desktop change detected matching pattern: ${pattern}"
              DESKTOP_CHANGED=true
              break
            fi
          done

          echo "desktop=${DESKTOP_CHANGED}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Desktop changes detected: ${DESKTOP_CHANGED}"

  verify-e2e:
    name: Verify E2E Passed
    needs: detect-changes
    if: startsWith(github.head_ref, 'release-please--')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 40
    steps:
      - name: Wait for Web E2E and verify it passed
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          # Get the latest commit on main (the base the release PR targets)
          MAIN_SHA=$(gh api repos/${{ github.repository }}/git/ref/heads/main --jq '.object.sha')
          echo "Latest main commit: ${MAIN_SHA}"

          # Poll for the Web E2E run to complete (it triggers on the same push)
          MAX_ATTEMPTS=30
          POLL_INTERVAL=30
          echo "Waiting for Web E2E run to complete (polling every ${POLL_INTERVAL}s, max ${MAX_ATTEMPTS} attempts)..."

          for attempt in $(seq 1 $MAX_ATTEMPTS); do
            E2E_CONCLUSION=$(gh run list --repo ${{ github.repository }} \
              --workflow=e2e.yml --branch=main --limit=10 \
              --json headSha,conclusion,status \
              --jq "[.[] | select(.headSha == \"${MAIN_SHA}\")][0].conclusion // empty")

            if [ -n "$E2E_CONCLUSION" ]; then
              echo "Web E2E completed with conclusion: ${E2E_CONCLUSION}"
              break
            fi

            if [ "$attempt" -eq "$MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; then
              echo "::error::Web E2E run did not complete within $(( MAX_ATTEMPTS * POLL_INTERVAL / 60 )) minutes for main (${MAIN_SHA})."
              exit 1
            fi

            echo "Attempt ${attempt}/${MAX_ATTEMPTS}: E2E still running, waiting ${POLL_INTERVAL}s..."
            sleep $POLL_INTERVAL
          done

          if [ "$E2E_CONCLUSION" != "success" ]; then
            echo "::error::E2E Tests did not pass on main (conclusion: ${E2E_CONCLUSION})"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Web E2E: passed"

      - name: Verify Desktop E2E (if desktop changed)
        if: needs.detect-changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          PREV_TAG: ${{ needs.detect-changes.outputs.prev_tag }}
        run: |
          MAIN_SHA=$(gh api repos/${{ github.repository }}/git/ref/heads/main --jq '.object.sha')
          echo "Desktop changes detected since ${PREV_TAG} — verifying Desktop E2E"

          # First check if there's a desktop E2E run for HEAD (may still be running)
          HEAD_STATUS=$(gh run list --repo ${{ github.repository }} \
            --workflow=e2e-desktop.yml --branch=main --limit=5 \
            --json headSha,conclusion,status \
            --jq "[.[] | select(.headSha == \"${MAIN_SHA}\")][0].status // empty")

          if [ -n "$HEAD_STATUS" ]; then
            echo "Desktop E2E run exists for HEAD — polling until complete..."
            MAX_ATTEMPTS=40
            POLL_INTERVAL=30

            for attempt in $(seq 1 $MAX_ATTEMPTS); do
              CONCLUSION=$(gh run list --repo ${{ github.repository }} \
